title: Guide to Driving in Tenerife: Roads, Tips, and Routes for Adventure
description: Explore driving in Tenerife with our guide on roads, tips, and scenic routes. Discover the best ways to rent a jeep and drive to Mount Teide.
content:
Introduction

Driving in Tenerife opens up a world of adventure, allowing you to explore the island's stunning landscapes at your own pace. Whether you're renting a Jeep in Tenerife for a thrilling ride or simply looking to navigate the local roads, this guide will provide you with essential tips, routes, and insights.

Understanding Tenerife Roads

Tenerife is well-connected by a network of roads that vary from urban streets to scenic mountain routes. Here are some key points to consider:

  • Highways and Main Roads: The TF-1 and TF-5 are the main highways, connecting the southern and northern parts of the island.
  • Mountain Roads: Roads leading to Mount Teide can be winding and steep. Ensure your vehicle is suitable for these conditions.
  • Local Streets: In towns, roads are narrower and may have limited parking. Always check for parking regulations.

Tips for Driving in Tenerife

To ensure a safe and enjoyable driving experience, keep these tips in mind:

  • Drive on the Right: In Tenerife, vehicles drive on the right side of the road. Familiarize yourself with this if you're from a country that drives on the left.
  • Speed Limits: Speed limits are generally 120 km/h on highways, 90 km/h on secondary roads, and 50 km/h in urban areas. Always observe posted signs.
  • Use of Seatbelts: Seatbelts are mandatory for all passengers. Ensure everyone in your Jeep is buckled up.
  • Mobile Phones: Using a mobile phone while driving is prohibited unless you have a hands-free system.
  • Alcohol Limit: The legal blood alcohol limit is 0.05%. It's best to avoid alcohol if you plan to drive.

Renting a Jeep in Tenerife

Renting a Jeep in Tenerife is a fantastic way to explore the island's rugged terrain. Here’s what you need to know:

  • Choose the Right Vehicle: Opt for a Jeep Wrangler for its off-road capabilities and comfort.
  • Insurance: Ensure your rental includes full insurance coverage for peace of mind.
  • Driver Requirements: You typically need to be at least 21 years old and have a valid driver's license.
  • Fuel Policy: Check whether the rental includes a full tank of fuel and if you need to return it full.

Scenic Routes to Explore

Tenerife boasts numerous scenic routes that are perfect for a Jeep adventure. Here are a few must-try routes:

  • Mount Teide National Park: Drive through this UNESCO World Heritage site, enjoying breathtaking views of the volcano and surrounding landscapes.
  • Masca Valley: This winding road offers stunning views and leads to the picturesque village of Masca.
  • La Orotava to Puerto de la Cruz: This route takes you through lush forests and offers coastal views.

Driving to Mount Teide

One of the highlights of driving in Tenerife is the opportunity to explore Mount Teide. Here’s how to make the most of your trip:

  • Plan Your Visit: Check the weather conditions before you go, as they can change rapidly in mountainous areas.
  • Time Your Drive: The sunset views from Mount Teide are spectacular. Aim to arrive at least an hour before sunset to find parking and enjoy the scenery.
  • Safety Precautions: The altitude can affect some drivers, so take your time and stay hydrated.

Conclusion

Driving in Tenerife is an exhilarating way to experience the island’s diverse landscapes, from coastal views to mountainous terrains. By renting a Jeep and following this guide, you can enjoy a safe and memorable adventure. Whether you’re heading to Mount Teide or exploring hidden gems, the freedom of the open road awaits you.
